messages:
maria-sales: Kicking off BlueHarbor POC. Buyer checklist: SAML SSO (IdP-managed), SCIM provisioning + group sync, RBAC that maps to our roles, domain ownership proof. Need a short runbook + two pricing options (hosted vs dedicated).

 devin-solutions: We support SAML 2.0 (SP & IdP initiated). We'll need IdP metadata XML and the signing cert. Supported NameID: persistent (email), transient. Do they need assertion encryption?

 maria-sales: They asked for encrypted assertions and signed assertions. Also want the ability to map multiple IdP groups into one Redwood role.

 isabel-eng: Encryption (AES) + signed assertions (RSA-SHA256) OK. On Hosted, encrypted assertions are supported but there's a Console step to upload their SP decryption key. For Dedicated/Private we can exchange keys directly. For group->role mapping, recommend provisioning groups via SCIM and mapping group.displayName -> role in Console. That's easiest for admins.

 trent-security: Security note: TLS1.2+ required, prefer TLS1.3. SCIM should use OAuth bearer tokens; mTLS available for Dedicated/Private. Ask BlueHarbor for cert thumbprint, NameID format, required attributes, token rotation policy, and IP allowlist if any. We'll send the questionnaire.

 devin-solutions: SCIM: we implement SCIM 2.0 endpoints: /scim/v2/Users and /scim/v2/Groups. PATCH for members supported. Bulk create up to 150 users per call. Group deltas are eventual; changes propagate to role caches in ~5-60s depending on load.

 isabel-eng: Quick runbook items I'll prepare: ACS URL, SP entityID, sample SAML attribute mapping, SCIM examples (POST user, PATCH group), troubleshooting tips (SAML logs location + common SCIM 409s).

 maria-sales: Pricing question: buyer wants example cost for 100-user POC and 1k production. Please include hosted per-API-call line and Dedicated reserved seat option.

 devin-solutions: Quick bullets I'll draft: Hosted: base + per-active-user/month + provisioning API metering (per-1000 calls). Dedicated: monthly reserved capacity (predictable), includes X provisioning calls; overage billed per-call. I'll add a worked example for 100 and 1k.

 trent-security: Domain verification options: DNS TXT verification (recommended) or MX/email challenge. We can enforce email domain allowlist and block external invites. For strict setups, Dedicated supports custom deny lists and CIDR-based IP allowlists for SCIM callbacks.

 ops-bot: [automated] Created ticket BH-POC-881 and attached initial SAML/SCIM checklist.

 isabel-eng: Adding sample snippets for the runbook below:

 ```
 POST /scim/v2/Users
 Authorization: Bearer <token>
 Content-Type: application/json
 {
   "userName": "taylor@blueharbor.com",
   "name": {"givenName":"Taylor","familyName":"Ng"},
   "emails": [{"value":"taylor@blueharbor.com","primary":true}]
 }
 ```

 ```
 PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/7c3f
 [ {"op":"add","path":"members","value":[{"value":"user-231"}]} ]
 ```

 ```xml
 <AttributeStatement>
   <Attribute Name="urn:oid:0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.3">
     <AttributeValue>taylor@blueharbor.com</AttributeValue>
   </Attribute>
   <Attribute Name="redwood:role">
     <AttributeValue>editor</AttributeValue>
   </Attribute>
 </AttributeStatement>
 ```

 maria-sales: Action items: @isabel-eng write the 1-page runbook + attach snippets; @trent-security fill questionnaire answers and send SOC/control links; @devin-solutions draft the two pricing options with worked examples. Target: 48 hours. I'll share with buyer after review.

 devin-solutions: ack :thumbsup:

 trent-security: I'll add a note about token rotation (recommend 90 days), and point them to https://redwood.ai/security/sso-scim for docs.

 maria-sales: Thanks team. Will reopen when metadata arrives.
